title: KHR_character_expression_suppression Suppression Properties
description: Defines one attenuation contribution from the containing source expression to a target expression.

target.description: Index of the native expression driver attenuated by this suppression.
target.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.gltf_detailedDescription: This name is independent of the target expression entry's name; no correspondence is implied or required. Resolution MUST use `target`, not this value.

type.description: Suppression type. 'blend' contributes amount times the source driver; 'block' contributes amount when the source driver exceeds threshold, otherwise 0. All attenuation contributions are summed and clamped per target. A custom value is shaped like a glTF vendor extension name and MUST be ignored at runtime unless a supported companion extension object on this suppression, keyed by exactly this value, defines its attenuation as one finite value in [0, 1].

amount.description: Attenuation amount used by the 'blend' and 'block' contributions.
amount.gltf_detailedDescription: On a custom type it has no standard meaning, and only the attenuation function of a supported same-object companion extension MAY read it. Such a function reads an omitted value as `1`, so omitting it gives the same attenuation as authoring `1`.

threshold.description: Strict source-driver threshold for a 'block' suppression. The suppression contributes amount only when the source value is greater than this value.
threshold.gltf_detailedDescription: On a custom type it has no standard meaning, and only the attenuation function of a supported same-object companion extension MAY read it. Such a function reads an omitted value as `0`, so omitting it gives the same attenuation as authoring `0`. Exporters MUST NOT write it when `type` is `blend` or omitted; importers MUST ignore it there.
